summary: The old 18-work lane index was fully dispositioned, a reproducible cutoff search added three nonredundant records, 15 canonical records across 14 independent source families were verified, and bounded claim cards were produced without manuscript synthesis or benchmark-result inference.

output_artifacts.role: reproducible search, verification, coverage, blocker, and local-gate report
canonical retained scholarly records and source-family metadata
bounded claim-source cards with locators and forbidden extrapolations
lawful acquisition state, rights, hashes, failures, and unresolved exact work
old and gap-search exclusions with decision reasons and degraded-access states
self-describing ARS handoff envelope; self-hash intentionally null

remediation_responsibility.evidence: All retained canonical records use full author lists, verified years/status, clean UTF-8, and no et al. shorthand or placeholder years.

Canonical-record and independent-family counts are separated; version/method dependencies, support scope, counter-evidence, and forbidden extrapolations are explicit. No manuscript synthesis was written.

Fourteen of fifteen retained records are original-content verified and locator-ready; the exact 2009 journal article is queued, flagged false for content/locator, and prohibited from production content claims.

unresolved_blockers.condition: No lawful exact-work full text was acquired by the cutoff.
unresolved_blockers.restriction: Do not use for a production-intended content claim until the exact artifact is acquired, inspected, and given an original-content locator.

downstream_constraints: H3 remains NOT_RUN; literature plausibility is not evidence of the v5 effect.
Do not call Apriori a ranking model on mining-only evidence.
Do not infer novel-item gain from aggregate basket gain.
Do not transplant paper-native metrics as v5 benchmark results.
Do not use the 2007 Liu-family conference predecessor as verification of the exact 2009 journal contents.
When held-out consequent membership defines cohort inclusion, use the name train-mined rule-aligned evaluation cohort rather than purely train-defined cohort.
Any v5 Full/No-Wide comparison must share the Deep branch, candidate universe, masks, seeds, tuning budget, calibration, tie-breaking, and target.

validation.note: The bundled runtime did not include the jsonschema package; validation used JSON parsing plus explicit checks for every required source-schema field, enum, type, locator hash pattern, source/claim cross-reference, and count invariant.
